title: EPLAN API capability catalog
description: Lines and documents in catalog/eplan-<version>/ (docs/design/2026-10-21-api-capability-coverage.md section 5). Generated by eng/catalog/EplanMcp.Catalog; never edited by hand. Fields that take their default are left out.

docId.description: XML documentation comment ID exactly as in EPLAN's IntelliSense files.

entry.description: One line of types.jsonl (a type) or members/<namespace>.jsonl (a member).

ns.description: Types only: namespace of the outermost type.

outer.description: Nested types only: the enclosing type.

group.description: Operation layer only: overload group, O:<declaring type>.<name>. A project key, not an EPLAN ID.

access.description: Visible to derived types only; absent means public.

returns.description: Return, property, field or event type; absent for System.Void.

setterAccess.description: The visible setter is protected; absent means no protected setter.

values.description: Enums only: name to value, sorted by name (ordinal). A value's ID is F:<enum>.<name>.

documented.description: The ID is not in the IntelliSense file; absent means it is.

excluded.description: Left out of the denominator by a mechanical rule (design section 3.3).

dictionaryProperty.description: One line of data-dictionary.jsonl: a property ID of an object type. Member IDs follow from summary.json layers.data_dictionary.byObject.<object>: P:<propertyList>.<name>, P:<propertyList>.<name>(System.Int32) and F:<enum>.<name>.

value.description: The numeric property ID, from the enum.

enum.description: No enum value; absent means there is one.

list.description: No plain PropertyList member; absent means there is one.

indexed.description: No (System.Int32) overload; absent means there is one.

summary.description: summary.json: counts per layer, object type, namespace and kind.
